milestones.name: Particle model
milestones.goal: Walk XSD content models generically so compositors other than xs:sequence carry their children.

tasks.description: Widen RawXsdComplexType to model xs:choice, xs:all and xs:group as real shapes rather than unknown placeholders
Extract a particle walker from buildElement so content models are traversed generically instead of reading xs:complexType.xs:sequence directly
tasks.notes: elementBuilder.ts:58 is the hardcoded read. This refactor is what makes M1 and M2 cheap; do it once and properly.

tasks.description: Support xs:choice, setting child cardinality min to 0 since only one branch is present in any instance
Support xs:all, which permits its children in any order
tasks.notes: Interacts with the generator, which currently emits children in schema order. Decide whether xs:all relaxes that or keeps declaration order.

tasks.description: Support xs:group definitions and references, expanding the referenced particle in place
Remove the xs:choice, xs:all and xs:group guards from assertSupportedElement and replace their tests with behavioural ones
tasks.notes: tests/lib/schema/unsupportedConstructs.test.ts currently asserts these throw. Each construct moves from a throwing test to a building-and-generating test.

milestones.name: Named type resolution
milestones.goal: Resolve named complex types, inheritance and element references so idiomatic XSD builds correctly.

tasks.description: Build a named complex type map in registryBuilder from the existing but uncalled extractNamedComplexTypes
tasks.notes: extractNamedComplexTypes exists in schemaParser.ts and is exported from the barrel, but has no production call site. resolveBaseType only consults simple types.

tasks.description: Expand a named complex type reference into its particle, carrying a visited-type set so self-referential types terminate
tasks.notes: Recursive types are legal XSD and would otherwise hang. This is the most idiomatic XSD construct the library rejects, so it is the highest-value task in the phase.

tasks.description: Support xs:complexContent with xs:extension, merging inherited members with locally declared ones
Support xs:simpleContent, where an element carries both text and attributes
tasks.notes: Only fully useful once attributes are modelled: simpleContent's whole purpose is text plus attributes.

tasks.description: Resolve xs:element ref against globally declared elements, stripping namespace prefixes
tasks.notes: Also requires relaxing the multi-root guard in registryBuilder, which currently throws before buildElement runs when a ref'd element is declared top-level.

tasks.description: Replace the named complexType, extension, simpleContent and ref throwing guards with behavioural tests

milestones.name: Attributes
milestones.goal: Carry XSD attributes through the registry and into generated XML.

tasks.description: Add an attributes field to SchemaElement with its own name, type, constraints and use
tasks.notes: Independent of the particle work: attributes hang off complexType rather than the content model. fast-xml-parser already surfaces them, since ignoreAttributes is false; buildElement simply discards them.

tasks.description: Parse xs:attribute declarations, including use="required" and default values
Support xs:attributeGroup definitions and references
Emit attributes in generated XML, escaped with escapeXmlAttribute
tasks.notes: escapeXmlAttribute already exists from the 0.2.0 work. The open tag in xmlGenerator has no attribute slot yet.

tasks.description: Validate attribute values against their own constraints, and report a missing required attribute
Decide and document how a mapping addresses an attribute path, then support it in mapCsvToSchema
tasks.notes: Open design question: an @ prefix (Root.Child.@id) is the XPath-flavoured convention and reads unambiguously against element paths.

milestones.name: Multi-document schemas
milestones.goal: Resolve xs:include and xs:import so schemas split across files can be loaded.

tasks.description: Add an optional resolve(location) => string callback to SchemaRegistryOptions
tasks.notes: Recommended shape: an injected synchronous resolver. It keeps buildSchemaRegistry synchronous so no existing call site breaks, keeps the package runtime-agnostic (the caller decides between fs, a bundled map or a pre-populated cache), and leaves room to add an async variant later. Going sync-to-async is additive; async-to-sync is impossible. Cost: a caller with only an async source must pre-populate a map.

tasks.description: Resolve xs:include, merging the included document into the including one under the same target namespace
Resolve xs:import, tracking the foreign target namespace per document
tasks.notes: Harder than include: types from an imported document belong to a different namespace, so the registry needs to disambiguate rather than merging blindly.

tasks.description: Detect circular includes and report the cycle rather than recursing
Throw a clear error when a document needs resolution but no resolver was supplied
tasks.notes: Preserves the 0.2.0 principle: fail loudly rather than silently producing a registry with content missing.

milestones.name: Coverage and hygiene
milestones.goal: Test everything the package exports and modernise the conventions the code still carries.

tasks.description: Test validateRows with a synthetic MappingConfig, replacing the ILR-coupled fixtures that blocked porting it
tasks.notes: The only exported function with no test coverage at all. Its Iris tests depended on facAirtableMapping and createAimSkipFilter.

tasks.description: Cover the remaining untested exports: schemaCompatibility, csvParser error paths, and the transform registry accessors
Enable noUncheckedIndexedAccess and fix the resulting indexed-access errors
tasks.notes: Deliberately deferred in 0.1.0 as too large. Measured since: 40 errors, mostly indexed access in columnMapper and elementBuilder. Each one is a real spot where an out-of-bounds index yields undefined at runtime.

tasks.description: Resolve the three TODO markers in schemaTypes.ts proposing that createIssue, createEmptyResult and computeResultStats move to a util module
tasks.notes: Either do the extraction or delete the markers. They have outlived the code they annotate.

tasks.description: Split the Node-only parseCSV from the pure parseCSVContent so the package stops importing fs/promises at module scope
tasks.notes: csvParser.ts:14 is the only Node coupling in the library. Everything else is computation over strings and plain objects, so the package would otherwise run anywhere.

milestones.goal: Commit to a stable public API and release 1.0.0.

tasks.description: Review the public barrel and decide whether the four schema construction helpers belong in the supported API
tasks.notes: parseCardinality, extractConstraints, buildElement, populateLookupMaps and the typeResolver pair were exported at 0.1.0 so the ported unit tests could reach them. 1.0 freezes whatever stays.

tasks.description: Remove the deprecated isoDate and isoDateTime aliases
tasks.notes: Introduced in 0.2.0 alongside passthroughDate and passthroughDateTime. A major bump is the moment to drop them.

tasks.description: Update the README's supported-XSD table and limitations section to match what the library now handles
tasks.notes: The limitations list shrinks to whatever M1 to M4 did not cover.

tasks.description: Write an API reference covering every export, its signature and its return shape
Add a runnable examples directory built on the existing test fixtures
Release 1.0.0 with a CHANGELOG entry and a stated semver commitment
